blocks.text: With the BLACK+DECKER dustbuster AdvancedClean+ Cordless Handheld Vacuum, you can easily clean everyday messes. With cordless convenience, you can use it as a vacuum for home and vacuum for car. The rotating slim nozzle let's you rotate 180° so you can get into those hard-to-reach places which makes this an ideal car detailing vacuum. The pull-out crevice tool is designed to help you get into those nooks and crannies while the flip-up brush is a great choice for dusting and cleaning surfaces like upholstery. A part of the growing BLACK+DECKER family of handheld vacuums. Easy By Design. ** Source: Circana Group/Retail Tracking Service, U.S. unit sales, 12 months ending October 2023

items: Cordless convenience - portable, rechargeable, lightweight for use around your home and in your vehicle
Multi-surface use removes hair, dirt, debris, and pet hair as stair vacuum for carpet, portable car vacuum, couch vacuum, furniture, and high-traffic areas
Compact design - easy to hold when in use and easy to store until you're ready to use again
Rotating slim nozzle - rotates to help you clean tight, hard to reach spaces
Pull-out crevice tool accesses hard-to-reach areas like between cushions and on top of shelves. Flip-up brush adds versatility for dusting
Cyclonic action spins dust and debris away from the filter, supplying consistently strong suction power
Optimal performance, car vacuum cleaner high power - 16v MAX lithium-ion battery provides high suction power and performance
Easy-view dirt bowl- A translucent, bagless washable dirt bowl empties easily for convenient debris disposal without you having to touch the dirt

items.label: Quick Tip
items.value: Empty the dustbowl after each use and clean the filter regularly. Cyclonic action helps, but routine maintenance keeps your vacuum performing like new
